draft_picks.about: Every live draft pick since 2009 (rounds 9+; rounds 1-8 are keepers). value = S&F value that season; slot_value = what that slot usually gives; net = value minus slot_value; kept_value = value later as a keeper (null if never kept).

keepers.about: Every keeper (rounds 1-8) by year, with his S&F value that season. round = keeper round.

na_keepers.about: NA (minor-league) keepers, rounds 25-26, with S&F value that season.

seasons.about: Every manager-season since 2009: category record (head-to-head categories won/lost/tied), winning pct, regular-season finish, final standing after the playoffs, made playoffs, seed, champion. 2020 was cancelled (no season).

trades.about: Every S&F trade, one row per team: what that team got, its trade grade (0-100, 50 = even; hindsight) and the grade at the time, and the S&F value it got. Off-season trades count toward the next season.
